Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Outcome of Interaction with Analyst/Institutional Investor - Regulation 30 of Securities 
and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 (“Listing Regulations”) 
 
This is further to our letter dated October 05, 2026, wherein we had given an advance intimation 
of interaction with Institutional Investors.  
 
In compliance with Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations, we hereby inform you that The 
Phoenix Mills Limited (‘Company’) on Thursday, October 08, 2026, participated in a meeting with 
Institutional Investor (Group Meetings) at Mumbai. 
 
The Investors were briefed on general business overview of the Company and industry updates.
